exposure: Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (V-NOTES)
cohort: The study included 62 patients undergoing hysterectomy, with exclusions for BMI >30, history of endometriosis, multiple cesarean sections, or uterine size >12 weeks.
finding: V-NOTES offers reduced postoperative pain and faster recovery compared to TLH, but is associated with a higher hemoglobin deficit.
